metadata.description: Wowbagger — a Git-native work ledger for coding agents with deterministic ready queues, guarded CAS mutations, claims and fencing, and self-contained HTML reports.

plugins.name: wowbagger
plugins.description: Coordinate coding agents through a Git-native ledger: validate, select ready work, inspect lossless item revisions, publish guarded mutations, and generate scoped HTML reports. Requires a separately installed matching Wowbagger core distribution; the skill refuses absent or incompatible core and contract versions.
